cards.text:
DUEL Orochimaru ⧗ You can upgrade over friendly characters with a different name than this character.
MAIN: Move a Hokage character in play.

cards.name: Enma
cards.title: "Surely you didn't summon me just for this."
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: At the end of the round, search your deck for Adamantine Nyoi and play it, paying 2 less. Shuffle the deck afterwards. Then, you must return this character to your hand.

cards.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
cards.title: "You were meant to guide them, not toy with them!"
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: When a friendly Leaf Village character is played in this mission, POWERUP 2 that character.
DUEL Orochimaru ↯ Play a Summon character in this mission, paying 2 less.

cards.name: Kurenai Yuhi
cards.title: "Alright… Let’s end this!"
cards.text:
DUEL Itachi Uchiha ↯ Defeat the strongest enemy character in this mission if they have at least 6 Power.
UPGRADE DUEL effect: Instead, defeat them if they have at least 5 Power.

cards.name: Haku
cards.title: "I face death for him."
cards.text: UPGRADE: Discard the top card of your deck. Hide an enemy character in this mission with cost less than the cost of the discarded card.

cards.name: Zabuza Momochi
cards.title: "A very simple plan can defeat you."
cards.text: MAIN: Defeat an enemy character in this mission that was played last turn for less than its printed cost due to a card effect.

cards.name: Itachi Uchiha
cards.title: "It isn't my desire to kill you."
cards.text:
UPGRADE: Return a friendly hidden character from this mission to your hand.
DUEL Kurenai Yuhi ↯ The opponent chooses and defeats their characters in this mission until they have the same number as your characters.

cards.name: Asuma Sarutobi
cards.title: "Now come on, out with it."
cards.text:
MAIN: Discard a card from your hand. Powerup X where X is the Power of the discarded card.
UPGRADE: Defeat an enemy character in this mission with Power equal to this character.

cards.name: Kabuto Yakushi
cards.title: "Time's running out."
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: When you play a Sound Village character, you must draw a card and then discard a card, if able.

cards.name: Iruka Umino
cards.title: " I can't help it. .. I still want Naruto to win!"
cards.text:
MAIN: Hide a Naruto Uzumaki in play.
UPGRADE: Play a Naruto Uzumaki while hidden anywhere, paying 2 less.

cards.name: Tsunade
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
MAIN: Shuffle up to 5 cards from the top of your discard pile into your deck. For each card shuffled, POWERUP 1.
UPGRADE MAIN effect: In addition, for each card, also POWERUP 1 a friendly character in play.

cards.name: Katsuyu
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: At the end of the round, you must return this character to your hand if there isn't a friendly Tsunade in this mission.
MAIN: Gain 1 Chakra for every friendly Tsunade in play.

cards.name: Gamabunta
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: At the end of the round, you must return this character to your hand if there isn't a friendly Jiraiya in this mission.
MAIN: Draw 1 card for every friendly Jiraiya in play.

cards.name: Jiraiya
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: When you play a Summon character, gain 1 Chakra.
UPGRADE: Play a Summon character anywhere, paying 3 less. POWERUP 2 every friendly Summon character in play.

cards.name: Orochimaru
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
MAIN: Defeat all enemy characters in this mission with cost lower than the number of cards in this upgrade stack.
AMBUSH MAIN effect: Instead, with cost equal to or lower than.

cards.name: Manda
cards.title: Battle of the Sannin
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: At the end of the round, you must return this character to your hand if there isn't a friendly Orochimaru in this mission.
MAIN: POWERUP 2 for every friendly Orochimaru in play.

cards.name: Naruto Uzumaki
cards.title: "I'm not letting Orochimaru take you away!"
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: Enemy characters cannot move out of this mission.
DUEL Sasuke Uchiha ↯ POWERUP 1 for every non-hidden enemy character in play.

cards.name: NARUTO
cards.title: The Final Valley
cards.text:
CONTINUOUS: Enemy characters cannot move out of this mission.
DUEL Sasuke Uchiha ↯ POWERUP 1 for every non-hidden enemy character in play.

cards.name: Sasuke Uchiha
cards.title: "This time we settle it one and for all!"
cards.text:
DUEL Naruto Uzumaki ↯ POWERUP 3.
MAIN: Defeat an enemy upgraded character in this mission with less printed Power than this character's Power, then you must move this character, if able.

cards.name: Kakashi Hatake
cards.title: "I will not allow my comrades to die."
cards.text:
MAIN: Search your deck for up to 2 Ninja Hound characters, reveal and draw them, then shuffle your deck. Play any number of Ninja Hound characters anywhere, paying 1 less.
DUEL Zabuza Momochi ↯ Repeat the MAIN effect.

cards.name: Zabuza Momochi
cards.title: "You're just brats."
cards.text:
DUEL Kakashi Hatake ↯ Move the strongest enemy character in play to this mission.
UPGRADE: POWERUP X, where X is the cost of the strongest enemy character in this mission.

cards.name: New Forces
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: If you play a character with a different name than any other character in this mission, POWERUP 2 that character.

cards.name: Reconnaissance
cards.text: SCORE: Look at a hidden character and then you may move them.

cards.name: Honorable Duel
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: If you have exactly one non-hidden friendly character in this mission, they have +4 Power.

cards.name: High Priority Mission
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: Score this mission twice (activating SCORE effects again, if any).

cards.name: Adverse Terrain
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: CHAKRA +2 for the player currently losing the mission.

cards.name: Keep a Low Profile
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: All characters in this mission have, after all their other abilities, "AMBUSH ↯ POWERUP 2".

cards.name: King of the Hill
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: Before determining Power in the Mission Evaluation phase, the character with the unique highest Power in this mission has +3 Power.

cards.name: Team Training
cards.text: CONTINUOUS: If you have exactly 3 non-hidden friendly characters in this mission, you have +5 total Power in this mission.

cards.name: Behind Enemy Lines
cards.text: SCORE: The opponent must draw a card.

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.text: SCORE: Discard an attachment in play.
